description.value: Agora is a student volunteer-run, not-for-profit café embedded in UBC's Faculty of Land and Food Systems, founded in 2005 and committed to affordable, organic, and locally sourced food. Every menu item is vegetarian, with many vegan options spanning baked goods, hot entrees like Chana Masala and Coconut Curry, and cold dishes. Cyclists exploring the UBC campus will find a community-minded spot focused on food security and sustainability rather than commercial throughput.
